<details>
The PKGBUILD defines multiple packages related to fonts and style assets for the 38th Chaos Communication Congress. The `source` array includes a ZIP archive from the official event website and an HTML file fetched from the same trusted domain. Both sources are hosted over HTTPS at `events.ccc.de`, which is the legitimate and expected upstream for this content.

The `sha256sums` array contains a valid checksum for the ZIP file and `'SKIP'` for the HTML file. As per the guidelines, a skipped checksum is not a safety concern for this phase, especially for a non-binary asset like an HTML file that will be audited later. There is no command substitution, `eval`, `curl`, `wget`, or other risky constructs in the global scope or in `pkgver()`. The `pkgver` is hardcoded as `2`, so no dynamic version fetching occurs.

All operations during sourcing the PKGBUILD are safe. The actual build and prepare steps (which involve `html2text` and file copying) are not executed under `--nobuild --noprepare`, so they are out of scope for this narrow gate. The package follows standard AUR practices and poses no risk during source fetching and parsing.
</details>
